name: damage_sound
description: DAMAGE SOUNDNESS, BOTH DIRECTIONS (E2E_PLAN c). Recoloring one 60x40 box must produce damage that (1) COVERS every pixel that actually changed (under-paint => stale pixels on screen), (2) satisfies PRESENT superset-of PAINT, (3) is TIGHT — its area is within max_overpaint_ratio of the bounding box of the pixels that really changed (over-paint => the perf bug that hides behind 'looks fine'), and (4) with pixel_identity, is PIXEL-IDENTICAL to an independent full repaint (CallbackInfo::take_screenshot re-renders from scratch with a fresh glyph cache — a different code path from render_display_list_damaged). Unlike assert_damage_covers_changes, a FULL repaint gets no free pass here: it is still measured for tightness, and forbid_full rejects it outright. FAILURE INJECTION EVIDENCE: shrinking the reported damage rects in cpu_backend makes it red with 'UNDER-PAINT'; inflating them makes it red with 'OVER-PAINT'; forcing the non-incremental path makes forbid_full red with 'the repaint was FULL'.
